metadata.title: software-android-design - Primary Sources
metadata.description: Material Design and Android developer references for native Android design guidance
metadata.note: Android 17 (API 37) shipped 2026-06-16; Android 16 (API 36) is the prior release. Google Play requires target API 36 for new apps/updates as of the 2026-08-31 deadline (existing apps: API 35 minimum), with a one-time extension to 2026-11-01. Material 3 Expressive components are split between stable material3 1.4.0 and experimental 1.5.0-alpha behind @ExperimentalMaterial3ExpressiveApi as of mid-2026. Re-verify all of the above at the URLs below before relying on a specific version number.

official_google.name: Compose Material 3 API Reference
official_google.description: Kotlin API reference for Compose Material 3 components. Stable material3 was 1.4.0 with Expressive-specific APIs in 1.5.0-alpha behind @ExperimentalMaterial3ExpressiveApi as of mid-2026 — verify current stable/alpha split at https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/compose-material3

official_google.name: Material 3

official_google.name: Android 16 Platform
official_google.description: Android 16 (API 36) behavior/platform changes incl. large-screen resizability/orientation, mandatory edge-to-edge, and predictive back defaults. Prior release as of 2026-07-11 — Android 17 (API 37) shipped 2026-06-16. Verify specifics at use-time.

official_google.name: Android 17 Release Notes
official_google.description: Android 17 (API level 37) shipped 2026-06-16 and is the current platform release as of this validation. Verify current release before treating any specific API number as latest.

official_google.name: Google Play Target API Requirements
official_google.description: Google Play target-API deadline (moves roughly annually). As of 2026-07-11: new apps/updates must target API 36 by 2026-08-31 (one-time extension to 2026-11-01), existing apps must target at least API 35. Re-check before citing a specific number.

official_google.name: Predictive Back Gesture Guide
official_google.description: Predictive back is mandatory system behavior for apps targeting API 36+ on Android 16+ devices; onBackPressed()/KEYCODE_BACK are no longer dispatched at that target. Use PredictiveBackHandler (Compose) or OnBackInvokedCallback.
